data.name: Hint
data.value: A car the company puts at your disposal, which you also use privately. The company pays its costs out of its profit, before your pay, and deducts them as its order date, its engine and its CO2 allow; you are taxed on a flat benefit in kind as part of your pay, though it is never paid in cash.

data.name: Scope
data.value: Netto counts an electric, fuel, hybrid or plug-in hybrid car ordered or leased by the end of the year.

data.name: CatalogueHint
data.value: The car's price new for a private buyer, options and VAT included, any discount left out, as on its order or the maker's price list.

data.name: RegistrationHint
data.value: The month and year of its first registration, on its registration certificate. Its benefit falls each year from that month, a month begun counting whole.

data.name: CostsHint
data.value: Everything the car costs the company over the year, lease or depreciation, fuel or charging, insurance, upkeep and taxes, as the company bears them, the VAT it cannot recover included.

data.name: ContributionHint
data.value: What you pay the company for the car's private use, if anything.

data.name: NoCarYet
data.value: Enter its catalogue value to see its figures.

data.name: AddBackReading
data.value: It adds back 40% because it pays your private charging: the law says « fuel », and the administration reads it as the charging of an electric car.

data.name: PrivateCostHint
data.value: A private lease of the same car, or what owning and running it would cost you over the year: its depreciation, fuel or charging, insurance, upkeep and taxes, VAT included.

data.name: PayHeld
data.value: Both plans run at {0} of pay, the most the company can pay once the car's costs are paid, so the difference is the car's alone.

data.name: Private_Waiting
data.value: Enter it to weigh both cars.

data.name: Private_Gain
data.value: The company car leaves you {0} more than a private one.

data.name: Private_Loss
data.value: The company car costs you {0} more than a private one.

data.name: Private_Tie
data.value: The company car costs you what a private one would.

data.name: Remove
data.value: Remove the company car from your plan

data.name: EngineHint
data.value: Its engine, as on its registration certificate. A hybrid charges its battery as it drives; a plug-in hybrid also from a socket.

data.name: Co2Hint
data.value: In grams per kilometre, as the vehicle registration holds it: on its registration certificate or its certificate of conformity.

data.name: NoCo2Label
data.value: No CO2 figure is registered for it

data.name: AcquiredHint
data.value: The month and year the company ordered it, even before it was delivered, or signed its lease or rental contract. What the company may deduct of its costs rests on that date.

data.name: FakeHybridHint
data.value: A plug-in hybrid bought or leased from 2018 whose battery holds less than 0.5 kWh per 100 kg of the car, or that emits more than 50 g/km, 75 g/km under Euro 6e-bis. The SPF lists them with their matching cars.

data.name: MatchingCo2Hint
data.value: The CO2 of the same car running on its fuel alone, as the SPF's list of matching cars gives it.

data.name: SmallGasLabel
data.value: It has less than 12 fiscal horsepower

data.name: PrivateEnergy_Charging
data.value: The company pays my private charging

data.name: PrivateEnergy_FuelOrCharging
data.value: The company pays my private fuel or charging

data.name: PrivateEnergy_Fuel
data.value: The company pays my private fuel

data.name: PrivateEnergyHint_Charging
data.value: A charging point at your home whose electricity the company pays, or a charging card in its name, without reinvoicing you the charging of your private use.

data.name: PrivateEnergyHint_FuelOrCharging
data.value: A fuel card in the company's name, a charging point at your home whose electricity it pays, or a charging card in its name, without reinvoicing you what your private use takes.

data.name: PrivateEnergyHint_Fuel
data.value: A fuel card in the company's name, or the fuel of your private trips paid back to you, without reinvoicing you what your private use takes.

data.name: AddBackReading_PlugIn
data.value: It adds back 40% because it pays your private fuel or charging: the law says « fuel », and the administration counts a plug-in hybrid's charging as fuel too.

data.name: Co2_Electric
data.value: An electric car emits no CO2, so it takes the lowest percentage, {2}.

data.name: Co2_Registered
data.value: Its CO2 of {0} is measured against the {3} reference for its fuel, {1}: {2}.

data.name: Co2_WithoutData
data.value: With no CO2 registered, it counts as {0}, measured against the {3} reference for its fuel, {1}: {2}.

data.name: Co2_MatchingCar
data.value: As a fake hybrid, it counts at its matching car's {0}, measured against the {3} reference for its fuel, {1}: {2}.

data.name: Co2_OwnTimesMultiplier
data.value: As a fake hybrid without a matching car, it counts at its own CO2 times 2.5, {0}, measured against the {3} reference for its fuel, {1}: {2}.

data.name: Co2_HeldToMinimum
data.value: CO2 percentage held to the lowest: its CO2 would give less.

data.name: Co2_HeldToMaximum
data.value: CO2 percentage held to the highest: its CO2 would give more.

data.name: Car_FakeHybrid
data.value: a fake hybrid, its matching car's CO2 {0}

data.name: Car_FakeHybrid_NoMatching
data.value: a fake hybrid with no matching car

data.name: Car_FakeHybrid_NotGiven
data.value: a fake hybrid, its matching car's CO2 not given

data.name: Car_FakeHybrid_NotYet
data.value: its own CO2 counts: the fake-hybrid rule starts in {0}

data.name: Figure_Benefit
data.value: Car's benefit in kind before your contribution

data.name: Help_Period
data.value: At the share of its catalogue value the car's age leaves, weighed by the days of the period.

data.name: Figure_BenefitTaxed
data.value: Car's benefit in kind after your contribution

data.name: Help_BenefitTaxed
data.value: It is taxed as your pay, though never paid in cash.

data.name: Help_Deduction_None
data.value: Only the part equal to your benefit taxed and your contribution: its order date, its engine and its CO2 leave nothing more deductible. What it cannot deduct is added back to its taxable income.

data.name: Help_Deduction_Rate
data.value: The part equal to your benefit taxed and your contribution in full, and the rest at {0}, the rate its order date, its engine and its CO2 give. What it cannot deduct is added back to its taxable income.

data.name: Help_AddBack
data.value: The company adds this share of the benefit before your contribution back to its taxable income.

data.name: Help_TaxesOnPay
data.value: On Director pay, where its benefit is taxed with your pay.

data.name: Figure_Benefit_Minimum
data.value: Car's benefit in kind, the year's minimum, before your contribution

data.name: Help_Minimum
data.value: Its catalogue value, at its CO2 percentage and the share its age leaves, gives {0}, less than the minimum the law sets for the year. It is taxed as your pay, though never paid in cash.

data.name: Figure_Co2_Electric
data.value: CO2 percentage of an electric car, the minimum

data.name: Figure_NotDeductible_Rate
data.value: Costs the company cannot deduct, at a deduction rate of {0}
